title: The Room You Didn't Know Was There
core_idea: A common dream of discovering an unknown room in a familiar house can be read, if it resonates, as a gentle image of unexplored parts of ourselves.
text: Many people have a dream like this. You are walking through a house you know well, and suddenly there is a door you have never seen. Behind it, a whole room. Sometimes dusty, sometimes full of light. Some who work with dreams see the house as an image of the self, and a hidden room as a part of you that is waiting to be noticed. A talent you set aside. A feeling you never had time for. No one can tell you exactly what your room means. But if you have dreamed it, you might ask yourself, gently, what in your life has been closed off for a while? And would you like to open that door again?
description: A quiet reflection on the dream of finding a hidden room, and what it might invite you to explore.
